description: Apache-2.0 schema-driven classification with a DeBERTa-v3-large encoder and GLiNER2 preprocessing and scoring, executed by the Models Java encoder with Rust FFM shims. Qualified against the publisher's own runtime under schema-classification-upstream-v2 on the released Models 0.5.12: identical labels on every evaluated request and three passing CPU performance pairs. The article-specific duplicate-detection adapter is not identified by this entry.
